description:
Goal: reduce the causal compiler work needed to compute json_roundtrip by making one completed dynamic recursive group produce one coordinated return result, rather than repeatedly re-deriving cyclic copies.

This ticket subsumes the implementation obligations formerly tracked separately by fz-kdt.177.16 and fz-kdt.177.9. They are closed as superseded before implementation; their requirements live here. One commit, one PR, and one close deliver this atomic cut.

Why atomic: the tested loop(&loop/2, n) witness shows that adding a resolved value-call edge turns Recursive false→true and exposes a non-quiescing per-activation return cycle even when the group has a constant ground result. A graph-only landing is therefore unsafe.

Prerequisites: the implementation branch must contain both fz-kdt.98.1 (function-reference construction edges) and fz-kdt.177.15 (derivation-owned ReturnType payloads). Verify the actual merge base before editing; tracker state is not evidence that either change is present.

One model, three layers:

1. Replace the body-only StaticCallees representation with CallGraphCallees: the sole FunctionId → ordered FunctionId-set fact for the call graph. DeriveStaticCallees contributes direct and construction edges from the lowered body. Each AnalyzeActivation contributes only its effective resolved ClosureCall function targets. Use the existing ContributionMap and scheduler output frontier: extend while an analysis waits, exact-replace on conclusion/rebase, and withdraw only that publisher on removal. Provider boundaries are not function edges. The joined fact changes only when its set changes; DeriveCallGraphComponent remains its only SCC consumer.

2. Retain the demanded activation inventory of a component as ComponentActivations(ActivationComponent). ActivationComponent is the one new coordinate: { root, canonical_component }. Root is required because an ActivationKey is root-specific; a function component alone would conflate independent demand products. TrackActivationComponent(ActivationKey) reads exactly Activation(key) and CallGraphComponent(key.function), and contributes {key} to its current coordinate. On an absent activation it concludes exact-empty, so old membership retracts. The inventory is sorted by ActivationKey semantic order. It is the only inverse-membership authority: no World scan, activation-map scan, reverse cache, or second SCC traversal.

3. SolveRecursiveReturns(ActivationComponent) consumes a settled ComponentActivations fact and is the sole ReturnType publisher while its component is recursive. It publishes one derivation-owned result for each member in deterministic order. AnalyzeActivation continues to derive local analysis and targets but relinquishes ReturnType ownership for recursive members. The solver reads only external return evidence; an internal copy edge is structure inside the one group equation, never fresh ground or a separate wake. Validate all external observations before the coordinated publish. On membership, component, or ground movement, ordinary exact output replacement retracts obsolete member returns and establishes the replacement group. Non-recursive activations keep the existing AnalyzeActivation return publisher.

The existing pull recursive-group machinery is protocol prior art only: closed membership, deterministic staging, validate external reads, commit members together. Do not port its pending-product SCC search; CallGraphCallees and ComponentActivations are the semantic authorities.

TDD gates:
- A dynamic loop/mutual-call witness proves a resolved ClosureCall edge enters CallGraphCallees, forms the expected recursive component, terminates, and preserves its semantic/runtime answer.
- A one-ground recursive group proves one coordinated return publication per actual member; internal cyclic copies create no additional return ascent and wake an external caller once.
- In one retained compiler, remove the value edge or sole ground and prove exact membership and group-return retraction, no orphan contributor/payload, and no change to an unrelated grounded sibling or its artifact generation.
- FIFO, LIFO, and permuted admission produce the same canonical facts, component inventories, causal publishers, artifacts, and output. Compare semantic identities, never allocation/session IDs.
- Re-record the json_roundtrip product-pull baseline at the verified stack head, then prove the causal ReturnType ladder collapses through typed applied-event causes, job starts, analyses, and generations. Wall time is not a gate. Do not compare this run with a differently rooted standalone Compiler2 drive.

Update the pipeline/type-specialization and instrumentation guides with the final authorities and measured causal result. Remove the old ladder pin and temporary probes once the narrow causal contract replaces them.

Out of scope: fz-kdt.98.2/Reaches; a private resolved-edge map; a global scan; a second SCC engine; copying pull.rs into semantic jobs; μ closure; and deletion of return-widening or address-collapse budgets. fz-kdt.177.10 owns the latter work and follows this ticket.

comments.text: Implementation plan: (1) red loop(&loop/2, n) witness proves resolved value calls are missing from the existing StaticCallees authority; (2) retain one contributor-keyed edge aggregate for the existing StaticCallees fact, with DeriveStaticCallees owning body edges and AnalyzeActivation owning only its resolved targets; (3) use the scheduler output frontier for exact extend/replace/withdrawal, never a private activation edge store; (4) prove the false→true Recursive rebase and target withdrawal affect only the owner closure; (5) compare canon and json_roundtrip causal counts. fz-kdt.98.2/Reaches remains out of scope.

Atomicity finding: the red resolved-value SCC witness was implemented against a contribution-backed StaticCallees aggregate, then exercised. Once the value edge completes the SCC, the current per-activation return path does not quiesce, even when the recursive target returns a constant and the back edge is an unused FunctionRef. This is fz-kdt.177.9’s cyclic-copy failure, not an implementation detail of the edge store. Landing complete dynamic SCC membership without the group return solver would turn a valid program into nontermination. Scratch implementation and witness were removed; no source diff remains. Need a ticket-boundary decision: make .98.3 + .177.16 + .177.9 one atomic landing unit, or identify a semantic boundary that disproves this dependency.

title: Complete the dynamic recursive return cut atomically
